sentences.en: I found a nickel in between the couch cushions.
sentences.zh: 我在沙发垫子里发现了一枚五分硬币。

sentences.en: Nickel is a hard metal with a silvery luster.
sentences.zh: 镍是一种具有银白色光泽的坚硬金属。

sentences.en: Earth has a core of molten iron and nickel.
sentences.zh: 地球的核心是由熔融的铁和镍组成的。

senses.zh: （金属）镍；（美国或加拿大的）五分硬币
